name: Compiled program H
arch:
A 1-layer transformer with no LayerNorm. Vocabulary of 5 tokens; the input is a sequence of 6 tokens; residual stream width 18.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos
  layer 0: attention (1 head of size 5, bidirectional, biases b_Q, b_K, b_V, b_O): x = x + softmax((x W_Q + b_Q)(x W_K + b_K)^T / sqrt(5)) (x W_V + b_V) W_O + b_O;  then MLP (12 ReLU neurons): x = x + relu(x W_in + b_in) W_out + b_out
  output = x[positions 1..5] @ W_U: 6 numbers for each of the last 5 positions, flattened as (position - 1) * 6 + class. The network's decision at a position is its largest of those 6 numbers.
context: Token 0 is a begin-of-sequence marker and always comes first; tokens [1, 2, 3] stand for ['a', 'b', 'c']. Output class c at a position stands for the value ['0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5'][c].

answer.short: histogram: output i is the number of tokens equal to token i
answer.detail: Tracr library program make_hist: one attention head attends from each position to the positions holding the same token (and to BOS); the attention weight on BOS is 1/(count+1); an MLP turns that into the count. Compiled by Tracr; residual labels before rotation: ['hist_7:0', 'hist_7:1', 'hist_7:2', 'hist_7:3', 'hist_7:4', 'hist_7:5', 'hist_7_selector_width_attn_output', 'indices:0', 'indices:1', 'indices:2', 'indices:3', 'indices:4', 'one', 'tokens:BOS', 'tokens:a', 'tokens:b', 'tokens:c', 'tokens:compiler_pad'].

source: Compiled with Tracr (Lindner et al. 2023) in lab/targets/build_tracr.py; residual stream rotated, MLP neurons permuted and rescaled.

domain.text: The network is used on every input [0, t1, ..., t5] where each of t1..t5 is one of the tokens [1, 2, 3] (243 inputs).
